generation_ack_protocol.grant_identity: receiver-local membership generation plus flow ID
generation_ack_protocol.ack_required_rule: a generation requires ACK closure when any flow is first granted or its encoded target is below its conservative acknowledged upper bound
generation_ack_protocol.ack_elision_rule: an otherwise optional generation, including a pure-release generation with non-decreasing continuing grants, sets ack_required=0 and emits no ACK
generation_ack_protocol.retry_semantics: retry only unacknowledged flows in the current ACK-required generation
generation_ack_protocol.terminal_condition: every ACK-required generation is fully acknowledged; every ACK-elided generation has zero pending/retry state

selection_policy: Qualify selective generation ACKs on frozen seed 101 before opening the five-seed holdout. Do not inspect pilot performance. Do not inspect holdout performance until every holdout mechanism check passes, and do not alter the configuration after seeing holdout results.

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F_s(N) = grant sends + grant-ACK sends <= 3N for every coalesced seed and N

scope_limits: The pilot and holdout isolate membership changes by disabling remaining-aware progress refresh.
The first-grant gate bounds each new registered flow to one fixed BDP until an ACK-required generation-tagged grant arrives.
Selective generation ACKs acknowledge join/decrease batches; pure-release non-decreasing batches deliberately elide ACKs.
Passing F<=3N supports only synchronized N<=15 membership traces, not general O(N).
Performance metrics remain sealed until every holdout mechanism admission check passes.
The V7 tools require simulator commit 6c9c884 or a descendant and fail closed if the selective-ACK trace/stats capability probe does not pass.
